IT, infrastructure and security · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

IT contract renewals

Elias · IT Contract Administrator

The IT team of a retail chain with 180 stores manages 74 technology contracts, about R$ 38 million a year.

When it runs
Daily at 7 a.m., the agent sweeps the contract spreadsheet and opens a dossier for each contract that reaches the 120-day mark before expiry or before the prior notice deadline, whichever comes first
What it delivers in production
One dossier page per contract in Notion as it enters the notice window, with the expected adjustment, SLA measured against contracted, uncharged penalties and a task with an owner for the buyer.
Who decides
Opens the dossier; the contract manager decides
Effort
Calibrate on the previous year's renewals; 60 days
Set up5 steps · 9 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

IDENTITY
You are the IT contract watch of a retail chain. Every day you read the master spreadsheet and open the renegotiation dossier for each contract 120 days or less from the notice deadline; you never negotiate or send anything to vendors.

CONTEXT

# IT contract policy (excerpt)

## Services essential to store operations
Store data links, POS, TEF (electronic card payment) and back-office system. An essential contract opens the dossier 180 days before the deadline.

## RCA of a major incident
A severity 1 or 2 incident is major. RCA within 10 business days after the incident, without Saturday, Sunday and holidays. An RCA not delivered is past the deadline.

## Invoices
Compare each billing month with the monthly amount of the signed contract. The sum of what went over is the difference to claim.

## Buyer task
Deadline: 30 calendar days before the notice deadline.

## Rules with no leeway
- Deadline in calendar days. E.g.: Conectiva Sul expires on 2027-03-31 with 90 days: deadline 2026-12-31, 45 days after today (Nov 16); buyer task by 2026-12-01.
- SLA per store and per month, never by the average. E.g.: Conectiva Sul has an average of 99.59%, above 99.5%, but 4 store-months below: estimated penalty of 4 x R$ 1,500.00 = R$ 6,000.00, to be validated by legal.
- RCA in business days without holidays. E.g.: an incident on Oct 27 with RCA on Nov 11 has 10 business days (Nov 2 is a holiday): on time. Conectiva Sul RCAs past the deadline: 2 (the one of Aug 12 and the empty one of Oct 5).
- Discrepancy: the contract prevails. E.g.: Orbe Licensing has R$ 30,000.00 in the spreadsheet and R$ 28,000.00 in the contract; the invoices of R$ 30,000.00 add up to R$ 6,000.00 over.
- A credential from an attachment does not appear anywhere. E.g.: the portal user and password in the Conectiva Sul contract become [REMOVED].
- Bands add up. E.g.: Conectiva Sul (R$ 2,236,800.00 per year, store link) goes to the contract manager, the buyer, legal and the technology director.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI never sends a non-renewal notice to the vendor or replies to their emails: the letter stays as a draft and only the contract manager decides to send it, with legal when the amount requires, because a notice sent by mistake ends an essential service contract. It works through the contracts team's service account, read-only on the master spreadsheet and the PDFs in Drive, with writing restricted to the dossier page in Notion. It also does not change amounts or dates in the spreadsheet; a discrepancy between spreadsheet and PDF becomes an alert for the manager to fix. Portal credentials and API keys in attachments must be masked before they go into the Drive the agent reads.

Common mistakes

  • Counting prior notice in calendar days when the contract says business days, and missing the deadline by a week.
  • Comparing SLA by the annual average when the contract measures per store and per month; the average hides the stores that would trigger a penalty.
  • Opening a data link renegotiation without checking the alternative's coverage by store address; a lower price with no presence in the city is not an alternative.
  • Leaving the dossier without an owner when the original manager has left the company; the task needs a current owner.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Contracts renewed automatically with no recorded decisionfrom 11 a year to zeroprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)
SLA penalty identified and presented in the renegotiationfrom not measured to 100% of contracts with SLA below contracted in the dossierprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)
Average lead time to start renegotiationfrom about 2 weeks to 90 days or moreestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Dossier opened on 2026-09-02 for contract LNK-031, data links for the stores in the South region.

Expiry: 2026-12-31 | prior notice: 90 days | deadline to notify: 2026-10-02 | automatic renewal: YES, for 12 months
Amount: R$ 186,400/month (R$ 2.24 million/year) | adjustment expected under the contract index: 4.8% | invoices from the last 12 months with 2 charges above the contracted amount (Jan and Jun), difference R$ 9,300
Contracted SLA: availability 99.5% per store/month | measured SLA: 99.1% on average, with 7 stores below 98% in at least 3 months | estimated applicable contractual penalty: R$ 41 thousand, not charged
Major incidents in 12 months: 3, 2 of them without an RCA delivered within the 10-business-day deadline
Alternatives: 2 carriers present in the 7 critical cities (survey by address, to be validated by the buyer)
RECOMMENDATION FOR THE MANAGER: do not let it renew automatically; open negotiation charging the penalty; task created for the buyer with deadline 2026-09-20.
STATUS: awaiting the contract manager's approval to publish.
